remarks: Downtown! Mid-rise elevator building w/premium reserved parking perfectly positioned near the stair-free building entrance - easy & efficient entry & exit! Modern, open & airy lobby featuring high ceilings & sitting area filled w/natural light. Also, light-filled, up-to-date laundry room on main level just off lobby. Heat, hot & cold water, cooking gas & reserved parking all included in the common charges. With its open floorplan, generous room sizes & floor-to-ceiling closet storage, this spacious 1 bedroom Condominium delivers great value at a price point that ensures a sound investment as you make upgrades & apply your own personal style & imprint. 2 brand new, SMART home, wifi-ready A/C units. Walk to UCONN, all downtown shops, restaurants & entertainment including Avon Theater, houses of worship, parks, Tully Center, tennis & track at Stamford High, pickleball, golf & so much more. Less than 1 mile to Stamford Metro North Train & I-95. The perfect place to hang any hat! Come hang yours today!
